Appearance:
 Shri Anshu Gupta - Advocate for the petitioner.
 Shri Harish Dixit Deputy Ga for the respondent/State
 Order

This first application under Section 439 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 has been filed by the applicant, who is implicated in connection with Crime No.197/2024 registered at Police Station City Basoda, District Vidisha (MP) for offence punishable under sections 344, 366, 376 (2) (n), 376 (3),
323 of IPC and 5/6 POCSO Act.

After arguing for some time on the merits of the matter, learned counsel for the applicant seeks leave of this Court to withdraw the bail application with liberty to renew his prayer for grant of bail,
after recording of court statement of the prosecutrix.
With the aforesaid liberty, M.Cr.C. is dismissed as withdrawn.
(MILIND RAMESH PHADKE) JUDGE (aspr) NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-GWL:19578 2 MCRC-43913-2024 Netram Sehriya vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 November, 2024
